title: Sr Administrator (Support & Operations)
description:
Sr Administrator (Support & Operations)

Hyderabad, Telangana

**Job Summary**
---------------

Job Description – Linux Administrator

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

Key Responsibilities: Target Cloud Provisioning: Deploy and configure target cloud infrastructure (Azure Virtual Machines, GCP Compute Engine, Virtual Networks, and Managed Disks) to receive migrating Linux workloads. Migration Execution: Install, configure, and troubleshoot replication mobility agents on source Linux servers using tools like Azure Migrate, ASR, or GCP Migrate for Compute. Pre-Migration OS Preparation: Audit and prepare source Linux operating systems (e.g., verifying LVM layouts, validating GRUB boot configurations, checking disk space, and ensuring compatible kernel versions). Post-Migration OS Remediation: Execute critical post-cutover tasks, including uninstalling legacy on-premises hypervisor tools (VMware Tools), updating network interface cards (NICs), rebuilding initramfs, and configuring cloud-native VM agents. L2 Incident Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve post-migration Linux boot failures, network configuration anomalies, and disk mounting (FSTAB) issues. Storage & Volume Management: Administer Logical Volume Manager (LVM), partitioning, and mounting of NFS/CIFS network file systems post-migration. Patching & Upgrades: Apply routine OS patching, security updates, and packages during migration prep windows utilizing Red Hat Satellite or SUSE Manager.

**Skill Requirements**
----------------------

4+ years of dedicated experience in enterprise Linux Administration (RHEL and SUSE). 2+ years of hands-on experience deploying and administering Linux instances inside Microsoft Azure or GCP. Proven hands-on experience executing server migrations using Azure Migrate, Azure Site Recovery (ASR), or similar replication tools. Strong working knowledge of Linux Volume Management (LVM), GRUB/GRUB2 bootloaders, and system initialization (systemd/SysVinit). Proficiency in writing and debugging Bash scripts to automate repetitive post-migration cleanup and validation tasks. Solid understanding of standard networking concepts (TCP/IP routing, DNS configuration, and SSH key management). Non-Technical Technical Runbook Discipline: Exceptional attention to detail when executing step-by-step technical migration runbooks during strict maintenance windows. ITSM & ServiceNow Operations: Practical experience adhering to Change, Incident, and Problem Management workflows in ServiceNow. Support & Collaboration: Strong team player who coordinates effectively with Storage, Network, and Database teams during complex application migration cutovers. Documentation: Ability to draft clear, technical standard operating procedures (SOPs) and post-migration validation checks.

**Other Requirements**
----------------------

Good to Have Skills: Basic understanding of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like Terraform or Ansible. Familiarity with containerized environments (Docker/Podman) running on Linux. Experience with multi-pathing configurations and SAN/NAS storage attachments. Soft Skills: Structured Problem Solving: Methodical, logical approach to diagnosing kernel crashes, network interface drops, or disk-mount errors. Adaptability: Resilience and flexibility to support weekend or off-hour migration cutover bridges. Clear Communication: Ability to communicate technical roadblocks and resolution statuses clearly to the Migration Lead. Certifications: RHCSA (Red Hat Certified System Administrator) or SUSE Certified Administrator, AZ-104 OR GCP Associate Cloud Engineer, ITIL v4 Foundation. Overview Role – Linux Administrator L2 Experience Level – 4-8 years Job Location – Bengaluru / Hyderabad Job Type – Full-Time Support type - 24x7 Operational Support & Project Engagements

title: System Administrator
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!

**Job Description**  
Manage, secure, and optimize the organization's on-premises and cloud server infrastructure, including Nutanix AHV, Windows and Linux servers, Active Directory, Veeam backup, infrastructure monitoring, and Microsoft Azure. The role focuses on reliable day-to-day operations, backup and disaster recovery readiness, security hardening, and automation of routine tasks using PowerShell or Python in an ITIL-driven environment.

**Responsibilities**

* Administer Nutanix AHV clusters, including VM provisioning, patching, capacity planning, and cluster health.
* Manage Windows Server (2016/2019/2022) and Active Directory, including server builds, patching, GPOs, DNS/DHCP, and replication health.
* Install, configure, and troubleshoot Linux servers running RHEL, CentOS, or Ubuntu.
* Own Veeam backup and restore operations, including job configuration, restore testing, retention, and DR readiness.
* Manage Azure infrastructure, including VMs, storage, networking, backup, and cost governance, and support a small Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) footprint.
* Maintain infrastructure monitoring in PRTG, including sensors, thresholds, alerting, and dashboards.
* Automate provisioning, patching, and reporting using PowerShell or Python.
* Manage incidents, requests, changes, and problems in line with ITIL practices and agreed SLAs, and maintain runbooks and documentation.
* Participate in maintenance windows, upgrades, and the on-call rotation.
* Support security hardening and vulnerability remediation across server and cloud infrastructure.

**Required Qualifications**

* 3–6 years of hands-on experience in server and cloud infrastructure administration.
* Production experience with Nutanix AHV.
* Strong Windows Server and Active Directory administration skills.
* Working knowledge of Linux server administration.
* Hands-on experience with Veeam Backup & Replication, including restores and DR drills.
* Monitoring experience with PRTG or an equivalent tool.
* Demonstrated experience managing Azure infrastructure, including compute, storage, networking, and backup.
* Scripting skills in PowerShell or Python.
* ITIL certification and experience working in an ITIL-aligned environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Exposure to Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) or Citrix.
* Exposure to VMware, OCI, or cloud migration projects.
* Experience with FreshService or similar ITSM platforms.
* Certifications such as Microsoft Azure Administrator (AZ-104), Nutanix Certified Professional (NCP), Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA), or Veeam Certified Engineer (VMCE).

**Educational Qualification:** BE/B.Tech/BCA/MCA, preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
